official_name: Stanford Center for Research on Foundation Models
notes: Stanford CRFM produces AI safety benchmarks including AIR-Bench and HELM Safety, used to evaluate foundation model safety properties.

data.description: Safety benchmark for evaluating foundation models across a taxonomy of AI risk categories.
data.notes: AIR-Bench defines a hierarchical taxonomy of AI risks used to evaluate model safety. Risk categories are identified by slug names. Published as academic research with an accompanying GitHub repository.
data._item_pattern_note: Item-level IDs — AIR-Bench risk category slug (lowercase hyphenated) — are not yet enumerated. A catch-all pattern ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$ was removed 2026-08-13: it matched any arbitrary token, fabricating resolution results for unrelated queries and polluting free-text search. Prior research note: Conceptual taxonomy — risk categories defined in the AIR-Bench paper and GitHub repository. No per-item URLs. Restore an item-level match_node once the real identifier list is confirmed (prefer known_values over an open pattern).
